newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nine tourists injured in New Zealand bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Nine tourists injured in New Zealand bus crash.

text.p: Nine tourists were injured when a tour bus crashed on Monday at Ninety Mile Beach, one of New Zealand's best-known scenic attractions, Television New Zealand reported.
The bus, carrying 18 people, overturned at Ninety Mile Beach in the far north of New Zealand's North Island.
An emergency service told One Network News the bus rolled into the beach's surf. The most seriously injured tourist was flown by helicopter to Whangarei hospital.
Eight others were driven to hospital.
The accident reportedly happened around 4 p.m. (0400 GMT).
Three ambulances and three fire service vehicles raced to the remote accident scene. Police had yet to confirm the nationalities of those injured.
